title: Support of a difference of currents
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every set U ⊆ ℝ^P and all currents S, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), the difference current S − T of the frozen contract (Sub instance, (S − T)(ω) = S(ω) − T(ω)) satisfies spt(S − T) ⊆ spt S ∪ spt T. Here spt R = U ∖ Z(R) (GeometricCurrentOn.support). The zero region Z(R) is the union of all open sets W with closure(W) compact and closure(W) ⊆ U such that R(ω) = 0 for every test form ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ W.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), (S - T).support ⊆ S.support ∪ T.support
